summary: Tested SC marking on pending MOs feature. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: SC button visible on pending MOs, 'Start SC' button shows for pending SC MOs, SC badge shows 'SC (No RM)' for without_material and plain 'SC' for with_material. Backend correctly skips material consumption for without_material SC MOs and creates SC orders at start.
passed_tests: POST /api/work-orders creates normal (non-SC) MO in pending status
PUT /api/work-orders/{id} marks pending MO as SC 'without_material' - saves correctly
POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start for without_material SC MO - no materials consumed, no DC, SC order created
PUT /api/work-orders/{id} marks pending MO as SC 'with_material' - saves correctly
POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start for with_material SC MO - materials consumed, DC created, SC order created
SC badge data correct: subcontract_type='without_material' for No RM, 'with_material' for plain SC
Pending SC MOs have is_subcontract=true (should show 'Start SC' button)
Pending non-SC MOs have is_subcontract=false (should show regular 'Start' button)
SC button visible on pending and in_progress non-SC MOs (data supports frontend logic)
Frontend: 'Start SC' button visible on pending SC MOs (MO-000011, MO-000013)
Frontend: SC badge shows 'SC (No RM)' for without_material MOs (MO-000019, MO-000020, MO-000017)
Frontend: SC badge shows plain 'SC' for with_material MOs (MO-000018, MO-000021)
seed_data_creation: Created test MOs during backend testing via POST /api/work-orders with is_subcontract=false, then marked as SC via PUT
context_for_next_testing_agent: SC marking on pending MOs feature verified working. Key findings: (1) SC button visible on pending and in_progress non-SC MOs (line 919 in ManufacturingPage.js), (2) 'Start SC' button shows for pending SC MOs (line 916), regular 'Start' for non-SC (line 915), (3) SC badge shows 'SC (No RM)' for without_material type (line 911), (4) Backend skips material consumption for without_material SC (line 2998-3000 in server.py), (5) SC order created at start for SC MOs (line 3080-3100). Test MOs created: MO-000011, MO-000013 (pending SC), MO-000019, MO-000020 (in_progress, without_material SC).
